name: Alistair Davies
bio: Alistair's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for Formula One, fueled by countless hours spent tinkering with go-karts. After graduating with a degree in Mechanical Engineering from Imperial College London, he joined a small racing team, quickly climbing the ranks from junior engineer to lead aerodynamicist. His meticulous approach and dedication to data analysis have proven invaluable throughout his career. He is known for his calm demeanor under pressure and his ability to foster a collaborative environment within his teams. Alistair believes that innovation stems from a deep understanding of fundamental principles coupled with a willingness to challenge conventional thinking. He joined Academy Motorsport with a clear vision: to build a team capable of consistently challenging for podium finishes.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly parted with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Alistair is of average height with a wiry build, often seen sporting a focused expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical sketches and ideas.
Has a peculiar habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
Insists on a specific brand of Earl Grey tea during race weekends.
